text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan isn't answering her phone,
so I
head out to search for her when...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to go see the ocean. Seeing all
that
blue helps put me at ease, and the
sound of the
waves is relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Also... I can talk with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling a little worried about Aston
Machan, I
decide to accompany her. She
does seem fairly
exhausted after
back-to-back races. I should
adjust her
schedule.
